name: Name
unknown_attachment: This comes from an addon that is not loaded. It is kept as it is and does nothing.
no_attachment_editor: This kind of attachment cannot be shown here.
start_physics: Drop the rig and see what it does
model_hint: What hangs here sits in model space and follows no bone: a collider for the whole body, a button on a panel.
generate_colliders: Fit a collider around every bone that holds geometry
collider.name: Name
collider.name.hint: What scripts and events call this collider. Unique within the rig.
collider.alignment.hint: Oriented turns with the bone and the entity. World-aligned stays square to the world and only follows where the bone is: cheaper, and it ignores the rotation.
collider.rotation.hint: Degrees, applied X, then Y, then Z. A world-aligned collider ignores it.
collider.modes.hit.hint: Melee attacks and projectiles land here instead of on the entity's box. The damage source tells which collider was hit.
collider.modes.interact.hint: A right click on it reaches scripts with the collider's name, like a button on a panel.
collider.modes.contact.hint: What it does to a body that walks into it. Push shoves it aside the way mobs shove each other, Solid stops it and can be stood on, and carries what stands on it as it moves. Moving with an animation, both pass their speed on.
collider.modes.force.hint: How much of its own speed a moving collider passes on to what it runs into. 1 sends it off as fast as the collider moves; 0 only pushes it out.
